name: How is an attorney assigned if I cannot afford one for my misdemeanor case?

mainEntity.name: How is an attorney assigned if I cannot afford one for my misdemeanor case?

acceptedAnswer.text: At arraignment, if you cannot afford an attorney, the court will appoint a public defender to represent you for free. You’ll meet them before court who will confidentially discuss your case.sandiegocounty​
